title: Grace Hopper at the UNIVAC
alt: Grace Hopper, in glasses, sits at the UNIVAC console reading a printout, with three colleagues around her: Donald Cropper, Kalpathi C. Krishnan and Norman Rothberg. The sloping console is covered in rows of switches and lights, with a keyboard below.
author: Unknown author
description: SI Neg. 83-14878. Date: June, 1957. Grace Murray Hopper at the UNIVAC keyboard, June 1957. Grace Brewster Murray: American mathematician and rear admiral in the U.S. Navy who was a pioneer in developing computer technology, helping to devise UNIVAC I. the first commercial electronic computer, and naval applications for COBOL (common-business-oriented language). In the photo, left to right: Donald Cropper, Kalpathi C. Krishnan, Grace Hopper, Norman Rothberg. Photo shows members of the Automatic Programming Department at Remington Rand UNIVAC.
